# Licences of the Zed theme files in this directory

Real-world Zed theme families used by `tests/conformance.rs`. Every file is an unmodified copy of
a theme file published by a Zed theme extension repository under the MIT licence. A theme whose
licence is unclear is not admitted. The test `every_fixture_has_a_licence_row` fails when a `.json`
file here has no row below. `ayu.json`, `gruvbox.json` and `one.json` (one directory up) are
Zed's own bundled themes; their licences are in `../LICENSES.md`.

The `edge/` directory holds small hand-written files made for this test suite (no third-party
content, same licence as the repository); they are not listed in the table.
